description: Create the KnowledgeObject Beanie model, add Jinja2 dependency, update config with Cloudflare KV settings, and register the new model in db/mongo.py
steps: Add 'jinja2' and 'markdown' to apps/backend/requirements.in (after the existing entries, alphabetically placed)

Create apps/backend/app/models/knowledge.py with all sub-models: ContentBlock, ContentMetadata, DerivativeHashes, GeneratedContent, and the KnowledgeObject Document class with Settings (collection name 'knowledge_objects', compound indexes for URL resolution, unique slug index, text search index)
Update apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py: import KnowledgeObject from app.models.knowledge and add it to the document_models list in init_beanie()
Update apps/backend/app/config.py: add CLOUDFLARE_KV_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, and INDEXNOW_KEY as Optional[str] = None fields in the Settings class
pip install jinja2 markdown in the working environment to make them available for subsequent features
acceptance_criteria: apps/backend/app/models/knowledge.py exists with KnowledgeObject Document class containing all specified fields and sub-models
KnowledgeObject is registered in init_beanie document_models list in db/mongo.py
config.py has CLOUDFLARE_KV_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_KV_NAMESPACE_ID, INDEXNOW_KEY
The app can be imported without errors: python -c 'from app.main import app'
verification: Run: cd apps/backend && pip install jinja2 markdown && python -c 'from app.models.knowledge import KnowledgeObject; print(KnowledgeObject.Settings.name)'
Run: cd apps/backend && python -c 'from app.main import app; print(app.title)'
